title: The Drive Shot (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop-rock 116 bpm bright acoustic guitar punchy bass tight snare hand claps horn stab call-and-response light Spanish phrase accent drilling cadence pickleball training song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Paddle back paddle back paddle back swing
Step with the front foot drive through the thing
Low to high low to high contact out front
Topspin topspin keep it short and blunt

[Pre-Chorus]
Drive drive drive drive
Step step swing step step swing
Drive drive drive drive
Through the ball low to high

[Chorus]
This is the drive shot keep it flat keep it fast
Aim for the feet make the volley not last
Drive drive drive drive bend the knees stay low
Drive drive drive drive watch the paddle go

[Verse 2]
Shoulder turn shoulder turn weight on the back
Push off the ground forward attack
Wrist stays firm wrist stays firm don't flick
Paddle face neutral one quick stick

[Bridge]
Targets at the feet
Targets at the chest
Targets at the hip
Drive shot is the test

[Outro]
Drive drive drive
Step swing step swing
Drive drive drive
Footwork is everything
